_meta.feature: Commercial Lines ExpertQuote - EQ SFP Country Estate Policy
_meta.note: Only the attached representative flow is generated.

LastName.sourceSentence: I generate and retain a RANDOM value matching "CE-[A-Z]{4}" as runtime value "LastName"

FirstName.sourceSentence: I generate and retain a RANDOM value matching "SFP[A-Z]{3}" as runtime value "FirstName"

OwnerPhone.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "3[0-9]{9}" in "Owner Phone"

OwnerEmail.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value matching "test@[a-z]{4}\\.com" in "Owner Email"

InsuredSSN.sourceSentence: I enter a RANDOM value consisting of fixed prefix "025", followed by 6 random digits in "ssn"

fields.description: Set the name of the XTestStepValue to the name of the buffer and the value to the value to buffer. ActionMode Input sets the buffer, Verify performs a verification.
